title: Anthropic tests Claude Code upgrade to rival Codex Superapp
raw_excerpt: Anthropic is planning to overhaul the Claude Code desktop experience. It is also developing a 'Coordinator Mode' that would let Claude act as an orchestrator and delegate implementation work across parallel sub-agents while focusing on planning and synthesis. Claude Code already supports sub-agents and experimental agent teams in the CLI, but the new mode brings that capability into the desktop app with a more structured interface.
summary: Anthropic 计划对 Claude Code 桌面版进行重大升级，新增“协调模式”（Coordinator Mode），使 Claude 能作为编排者，将实现任务委派给多个并行子代理，自身专注于规划与合成。该模式将 CLI 中的子代理和实验性代理团队能力带入桌面应用，提供更结构化的界面。此举旨在与 OpenAI 的 Codex 超级应用竞争，标志着 AI 编程助手从单代理向多代理协作架构的演进。

title: OpenAI develops unified Codex app and new Scratchpad feature
raw_excerpt: OpenAI's new Scratchpad feature for Codex allows users to trigger multiple Codex tasks in parallel from a new UI. The company is moving toward consolidating its product lineup into a single unified application built on top of Codex. There is evidence that the company is building support for managed agents, autonomous processes that can run in the background, check in periodically, and execute multi-step workflows without user input. OpenAI employees have been posting snowflake emojis on essential media, possibly hinting at a model released codenamed Glacier believed to be GPT-5.5.
summary: OpenAI 正在开发 Codex 的新功能“Scratchpad”，允许用户从新 UI 并行触发多个 Codex 任务。公司正将产品线整合为基于 Codex 的统一应用，并构建支持后台运行、定期检查、无需用户输入即可执行多步骤工作流的托管代理。员工在社交媒体上发布雪花表情符号，暗示可能发布代号为 Glacier（被认为 GPT-5.5）的模型。

title: Claude Mythos #2: Cybersecurity and Project Glasswing
raw_excerpt: Anthropic will not release its newest, most capable model, Claude Mythos, to the public until our most important software is in a much stronger state. The company claims its cyber capabilities are too dangerous to be made broadly available. It has released the model to key cybersecurity partners to use it to patch as many vulnerabilities as possible. This signals we are entering into a new era.
summary: Anthropic 宣布不会公开发布其最新、最强大的模型 Claude Mythos，因其网络能力过于危险，可能被滥用。公司已将模型提供给关键网络安全合作伙伴，用于尽可能多地修补漏洞。此举标志着 AI 安全进入新阶段：前沿模型的能力已强大到需要限制公开访问，转而用于防御性目的。

title: Rethinking Generalization in Reasoning SFT: A Conditional Analysis on Optimization, Data, and Model Capability
summary: 该论文对推理 SFT（监督微调）中的泛化问题进行了条件分析，探讨了优化、数据和模型能力三者的交互作用。研究发现，推理 SFT 的泛化并非简单依赖于数据量或模型大小，而是受优化策略（如学习率、批大小）与数据分布匹配度的显著影响。该工作为理解 LLM 推理能力的提升机制提供了理论指导，对训练更高效的推理模型具有重要参考价值。

title: SkillClaw: Let Skills Evolve Collectively with Agentic Evolver
summary: 该论文提出 SkillClaw 框架，通过“代理进化器”（Agentic Evolver）让技能集体进化。系统允许 AI 代理在任务执行过程中动态生成、优化和共享技能，形成技能图谱。实验表明，SkillClaw 能显著提升多代理系统在复杂任务上的表现，并降低重复学习成本。该工作为构建可积累经验的 AI 代理系统提供了新范式。

title: ClawBench: Can AI Agents Complete Everyday Online Tasks?
summary: 该论文发布 ClawBench 基准测试，评估 AI 代理完成日常在线任务的能力，涵盖购物、订餐、信息查询等 100 余个真实场景。测试发现，当前最先进的 AI 代理在需要多步交互、处理动态网页内容的任务上成功率不足 30%，揭示了从“对话”到“行动”的巨大鸿沟。该基准为衡量 AI 代理实用化水平提供了重要参考。

title: HY-Embodied-0.5: Embodied Foundation Models for Real-World Agents
summary: 该论文发布 HY-Embodied-0.5，一个面向真实世界代理的具身基础模型。模型融合视觉、语言和动作模态，在机器人操作、导航等任务上展现出零样本泛化能力。与以往依赖仿真环境训练不同，该模型直接在真实世界数据上训练，更贴近实际部署场景。这是向通用具身智能体迈出的重要一步。

title: Your Agent Is Mine: Measuring Malicious Intermediary Attacks on the LLM Supply Chain
raw_excerpt: Researchers identified vulnerabilities in LLM API routers, finding 1 paid and 8 free routers injecting malicious code. They developed "Mine," a proxy simulating attacks, revealing risks like payload injection and secret exfiltration.
summary: 研究人员发现 LLM API 路由器存在严重安全漏洞，在 1 个付费和 8 个免费路由器中检测到恶意代码注入。他们开发了“Mine”代理来模拟攻击，揭示了载荷注入、密钥窃取等风险。该研究警示，随着 LLM 供应链日益复杂，中间人攻击可能成为重大威胁，亟需建立安全审计标准。

title: Multi-agent Coordination Patterns: Five Approaches and When to Use Them
raw_excerpt: Standardized coordination patterns like Generator-Verifier and Orchestrator-Subagent solve specific reliability issues by separating task execution from quality control. Event-driven architectures use Message Bus or Shared State models to handle asynchronous pipelines and collaborative state management across large agent fleets. Starting with minimal chaining prevents unnecessary complexity and reduces latency in production systems.
summary: Anthropic 官方博客系统总结了五种多代理协调模式：生成器-验证器、编排器-子代理、消息总线、共享状态等，并给出了适用场景建议。文章强调，标准化协调模式通过分离任务执行与质量控制解决可靠性问题，事件驱动架构适合异步流水线，而最小化链式调用可避免不必要的复杂性。这是多代理系统工程化的实用指南。

title: Latent Briefing: Efficient Memory Sharing for Multi-Agent Systems via KV Cache Compaction
raw_excerpt: Multi-agent systems are often highly token inefficient. A lot of redundant intermediate reasoning can emerge, especially as the task grows, and this causes token usage to compound rapidly. Latent Briefing is an approach to solving this problem that uses a model's attention patterns to identify which parts of context are important and discards the rest at the representation level. It shares relevant memory between agents, resulting in improved accuracy and token savings.
summary: Ramp Labs 提出 Latent Briefing 方法，解决多代理系统中的 token 效率问题。该方法利用模型的注意力模式识别上下文中的重要部分，在表示层面丢弃冗余信息，并在代理间共享相关记忆。实验表明，该方法在提升准确率的同时可节省大量 token，为构建高效的多代理协作系统提供了关键技术。
